invariants.rationale: The method operates on 'data', so it is expected to be non-null for method correctness.
The 'func' parameter is used to create a mapper, so it must be non-null.
'parallelism' is used to control data processing, so passing a null value might not be valid.
Parallelism is typically expected to be positive to have any effect.
Parallelism should not typically exceed the number of data items unless data is empty.
